{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])
df_dedup = df_dedup.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Check if any patient with biomarker_baseline == -999 is in the deduplicated dataset
# First, find rows where biomarker_baseline == -999
mask_baseline_missing = df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999

# Get the patient_ids of those rows
patients_with_missing_baseline = df[mask_baseline_missing]['patient_id'].unique()

# Check if any of these patients are in the deduplicated dataset
in_dedup = df_dedup['patient_id'].isin(patients_with_missing_baseline)

print(f'Number of patients with biomarker_baseline == -999: {len(patients_with_missing_baseline)}')
print(f'Number of these patients in the deduplicated dataset: {in_dedup.sum()}')

# If any are in the deduplicated dataset, we should exclude them
if in_dedup.sum() > 0:
    print('Some patients with missing baseline are in the deduplicated dataset. We must exclude them.')
    # Exclude them
    df_dedup = df_dedup[~df_dedup['patient_id'].isin(patients_with_missing_baseline)]
    print(f'Number of patients after excluding those with missing baseline: {len(df_dedup)}')
else:
    print('No patients with missing baseline are in the deduplicated dataset. Safe to proceed.')"}
